        SELECT * FROM (SELECT source_type FROM financial_facts WHERE source_type NOT IN ('seed', 'manual', 'test', 'dummy', 'placeholder') AND company_id IS NOT NULL AND company_id >= -2147483648 AND tenant_id = %(tenant)s AND is_reported
          ORDER BY source_type LIMIT 1)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT (SELECT source_type FROM financial_facts WHERE source_type NOT IN ('seed', 'manual', 'test', 'dummy', 'placeholder') AND company_id IS NOT NULL AND company_id >= -2147483648 AND tenant_id = %(tenant)s AND is_reported
          AND source_type > sources.src ORDER BY source_type LIMIT 1)
        FROM sources WHERE src IS NOT NULL
      ), pairs(src, cid) AS (
        SELECT src, (SELECT company_id FROM financial_facts WHERE source_type NOT IN ('seed', 'manual', 'test', 'dummy', 'placeholder') AND company_id IS NOT NULL AND company_id >= -2147483648 AND tenant_id = %(tenant)s AND is_reported
          AND source_type = sources.src ORDER BY company_id LIMIT 1)
        FROM sources WHERE src IS NOT NULL
        UNION ALL
        SELECT src, (SELECT company_id FROM financial_facts WHERE source_type NOT IN ('seed', 'manual', 'test', 'dummy', 'placeholder') AND company_id IS NOT NULL AND company_id >= -2147483648 AND tenant_id = %(tenant)s AND is_reported
          AND source_type = pairs.src AND company_id > pairs.cid
          ORDER BY company_id LIMIT 1)
        FROM pairs WHERE cid IS NOT NULL
      ), counts AS (
        SELECT src, count(*) AS covered FROM pairs WHERE cid IS NOT NULL GROUP BY src
      )
      SELECT src, covered, (SELECT updated_at FROM financial_facts WHERE source_type NOT IN ('seed', 'manual', 'test', 'dummy', 'placeholder') AND company_id IS NOT NULL AND company_id >= -2147483648 AND tenant_id = %(tenant)s AND is_reported

        ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS stamp FROM counts ORDER BY src

          AND source_type > sources.src ORDER BY source_type LIMIT 1)
        FROM sources WHERE src IS NOT NULL
      ), pairs(src, cid) AS (

          ORDER BY company_id LIMIT 1)
        FROM pairs WHERE cid IS NOT NULL

        SELECT src, count(*) AS covered FROM pairs WHERE cid IS NOT NULL GROUP BY src
